# ArcDiagram

**Class:** `UltraCanvasArcDiagram` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasArcDiagram.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasArcDiagram.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasArcDiagram.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Nodes on a baseline joined by arcs

## Overview

@brief Arc diagram element Renders nodes on a straight baseline with edges drawn as cubic Bezier arcs above and/or below. Arc height encodes distance or is fixed. Arc width (and optionally opacity) encodes edge weight. Features: - Nodes on horizontal or vertical baseline - Cubic Bezier arcs above/below baseline - Arc height: proportional, fixed, sqrt-scaled, or strict semicircle (P4) - Arc width + optional opacity scales with edge weight (P3) - Node sizing: fixed, by value, or by degree count (P1) - Directed arrowheads at target or arc midpoint (P6) - Self-loop arcs (P7) - Parallel edge bundle height-offset stacking (P8) - Z-order by span — shorter arcs drawn on top (P9) - Rotated 90° vertical labels (P2) - Axis arrowhead extending past last node (P5) - Color legend panel (P10) - Hover and click interaction on nodes and edges - Tooltip showing node/edge details

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasArcDiagram> CreateArcDiagram( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float width, float height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasArcDiagram(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onNodeClick` | `std::function<void(int, const ArcNode&)> onNodeClick` | / Fired when a node is clicked / @param int — node index; const ArcNode& — node data |
| `onEdgeClick` | `std::function<void(int, const ArcEdge&)> onEdgeClick` | / Fired when an edge is clicked / @param int — edge index; const ArcEdge& — edge data |
| `onNodeHover` | `std::function<void(int, const ArcNode&)> onNodeHover` | / Fired when mouse enters a node |
| `onEdgeHover` | `std::function<void(int, const ArcEdge&)> onEdgeHover` | / Fired when mouse enters an arc edge (at the apex region) |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `ArcEdgeType`

/ Which side of the baseline arcs are drawn on

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AboveBaseline` | /&lt; Arc curves above the baseline (forward links, default) |
| `BelowBaseline` | /&lt; Arc curves below the baseline (back links, secondary) |
| `Auto` | /&lt; Above when source &lt; target index, below otherwise |

### enum `ArcLabelSide`

/ Where node labels are positioned relative to the node dot

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BelowBaseline` | /&lt; Labels below the baseline (default) |
| `AboveBaseline` | /&lt; Labels above the baseline |
| `Alternating` | /&lt; Alternates above/below by index — reduces overlap for dense graphs |
| `Vertical` | /&lt; P2 — labels rotated 90° descending below baseline (image 1 style) |

### enum `ArcHeightMode`

/ Controls how arc height (curvature) scales with edge span

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Proportional` | /&lt; Arc height proportional to distance between nodes (default) |
| `Fixed` | /&lt; All arcs same fixed height regardless of span |
| `Sqrt` | /&lt; Arc height = sqrt(distance) × scale — compresses long arcs |
| `Semicircle` | /&lt; P4 — perfect D-shape: height = span/2 (images 1, 2, 4 style) |

### enum `ArcOrientation`

/ Axis orientation of the node baseline

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Horizontal` | /&lt; Nodes laid out left-to-right (default) |
| `Vertical` | /&lt; Nodes laid out top-to-bottom |

### enum `ArcArrowPosition`

/ P6 — where arrowheads are placed on directed edges

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AtTarget` | /&lt; Arrowhead at the target node end (default) |
| `AtMidArc` | /&lt; Arrowhead at the arc apex midpoint (image 3 style) |

### enum `ArcNodeSizeMode`

/ P1 — how node radius is determined

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Fixed` | /&lt; All nodes use ArcNode.size directly (default) |
| `ByValue` | /&lt; size = baseSize * sqrt(node.value) |
| `ByDegree` | /&lt; P1 — size = baseSize * sqrt(connectionCount) — image 1 style |

### enum `ArcValueDisplay`

/ P12 — what to render automatically at the arc apex (zenit)

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoLabel` | /&lt; No auto-generated apex label (default; honors edge.label) |
| `Value` | /&lt; Show edge weight as numeric value |
| `Percentage` | /&lt; Show edge weight as percentage of total edge weight |
